name: instant-worker — flow_test silent death [synthetic runner stopped reporting]
description: P1 when the synthetic flow runner stops emitting entirely for 15m while it is supposed to be enabled — a monitoring blind spot where the matrix would show stale-green. A flow that STOPS reporting is itself a failure (the worker's flow_synthetic job stopped ticking: River pool wedged, worker crashloop, or the periodic job de-registered). This NRQL counts the distinct InstantFlowTest events in the window; LOSS of signal (count drops to 0) under a 15m window is the trigger. IMPORTANT: only meaningful once FLOW_SYNTHETIC_ENABLED=true — before enablement no events is expected, so this condition is wired with a loss-of-signal expiration (openViolationOnExpiration) and should be ENABLED only on clusters where the flag is on (operator step). Source: worker/internal/jobs/flow_synthetic.go.

nrql.query: SELECT count(*) FROM InstantFlowTest WHERE cohort = 'synthetic'
